exposure: lack of information about advantages of breastfeed
cohort: 139 mothers in postnatal wards of a tertiary care hospital in Rohtak city, India, interviewed within 7 days of delivery.
finding: The study found that 40% of mothers initiated breastfeeding within 1 hour, with cesarean section and postnatal fatigue being common causes for delayed initiation, alongside other maternal and systemic factors.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was identified as a common cause for delayed breastfeeding initiation.
cross-section timing: Mothers were interviewed within 7 days of delivery (between Jan 2-9, 2015).
